title: Note from Helsik

sources.title: Devil's Fee
markers: Stealing or looting the {{SmRarityItem|Note from Helsik}}

summary: A clue to Helsik’s services that can move the quest marker to the Devil’s Fee and unlock her Curated Selection.

fields.Quest use: Loot or steal this clue from Gortash to reveal Helsik as a diabolist. Bring up the clue with her to unlock her Curated Selection and discuss passage to the House of Hope.
